Message.Name: Issue Symbol Directory Message
Message.Description: Issue Symbol Directory Message providing reference data for NASDAQ-listed securities. To be retired in Q1 2027 in favor of the Enhanced Issue Symbol Directory Message (Type F).

Message.Name: Enhanced Issue Symbol Directory Message
Message.Description: Enhanced Issue Symbol Directory Message — introduced in v3.0 alongside the existing Issue Symbol Directory Message (Type B) to support the SEC MPI Tick Rule (Nov 2026) and Extended Operational Hours (Dec 6, 2026). Adds ETP/IPO/MPI/Trading-State/Halt-Reason/Reg-SHO fields and two RESERVED prior-close prices.

Field.Name: MPI Tick
Field.Description: MPI Tick Rule. All symbols carry Penny MPI until Half-Penny MPI is introduced Nov 2026 per SEC mandate.

Field.Name: Trading State
Field.Description: Trading State (halted / trading) at the time of dissemination

Field.Name: Halt Reason
Field.Description: Reason for Halt, when Trading State indicates halted

Field.Name: Consolidated Prior Day Close Price
Field.Description: RESERVED. Consolidated prior day's close, adjusted if needed. Populated beginning December 6, 2026 when supported by the Listing Market.

Field.Name: Listing Market Official Prior Day Close Price
Field.Description: RESERVED. Listing Market's official prior day's close, adjusted if needed. Populated beginning December 6, 2026 when supported by the Listing Market.

Message.Name: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restricted Indicator Message
Message.Description: Reg SHO Restriction Indicator Message indicating the Rule 201 status for NASDAQ-listed securities. Snap-Shot sends a full spin of all active securities reflecting the current Reg SHO Action.

Message.Name: Cross SRO Trading Action Message
Message.Description: Cross SRO Trading Action message. In Snap-Shot, sent only for NASDAQ-listed issues currently halted, in a Quote Resumption, or in a LULD pause. Absence implies the issue is eligible for normal quoting and trading.

Field.Name: Trading Action Sequence Number
Field.Description: Trading Action Sequence Number (UTP SIP internal use only — data recipients should disregard)

Field.Name: Action Time
Field.Description: Timestamp of when the action occurred

Message.Name: Market Center Trading Action Message
Message.Description: Market Center Trading Action message — sent when a UTP participant invokes or releases a market center-specific trading halt for a NASDAQ-listed security. Other participants may continue to quote and trade.

Field.Name: Action Time
Field.Description: Timestamp of when the action occurred

Message.Name: Market Wide Circuit Breaker Decline Level Message
Message.Description: MWCB Decline Message. Communicates the daily MWCB breach points (Levels 1/2/3) set based on the prior day's closing value of the S&P 500 index. May be re-sent if levels are reset due to erroneous activity; participants should use the most recently disseminated values.

Message.Name: Limit Up Limit Down Price Band Message
Message.Description: Limit Up – Limit Down Price Band Message. Reflects the current LULD band for LULD-eligible securities. Designed to prevent trades outside specified Upper and Lower Limit Price Bands.

Field.Name: Limit Down Price
Field.Description: Limit Down Price, 6 implied decimal places

Field.Name: Limit Up Price
Field.Description: Limit Up Price, 6 implied decimal places

Message.Name: Auction Collar Message
Message.Description: Auction Collar Message published by primary markets using an automated reopening after a LULD Trading Pause. Snap-Shot sends only the most recent Auction Collar message per security.

Field.Name: Collar Reference Price
Field.Description: Reference price used to set collar

Field.Name: Collar Extension Indicator
Field.Description: Collar Extension Indicator. First collar at the pause is 0; increments by 1 for each new collar issued during the pause; resets to 0 on a new pause event.

Message.Name: Snapshot Sequence Message
Message.Description: Snapshot Sequence Number Message. Reflects the UTP Data Service sequence number at the time the UTP Snap-Shot spin was requested. To stay current, firms should process real-time UTP Data Service messages beginning with the next sequence number after this value.

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: UTP Data Service quotation-feed sequence number at the time the Snap-Shot was taken. Begin real-time processing from the next sequence.

Message.Name: Start of Day Message
Message.Description: Start of Day Control Message. Each day, signals that all subsequent data transmitted will be real-time updates. Prior to 03:58 the data feed handler may be broadcasting heartbeats.

Message.Name: Market Session Open Message
Message.Description: Market Session Open Control Message. Signifies the opening of market systems for the Normal Market Session. Each UTP participant may choose to provide its own Market Session Open control message.

Message.Name: Market Session Close Message
Message.Description: Market Session Close Control Message. Signals the closing of market systems for the Normal Market Session.

Message.Name: End of Day Message
Message.Description: End of Day Control Message. Signals the end of active message dissemination for the UTP SIP operational cycle.

Message.Name: End of Transmissions Message
Message.Description: End of Transmissions Control Message. Last production message of the day; signals no further transmissions through the UTP SIP line.

Message.Name: UTP Combined Quote Message Long Form
Message.Description: Long-format UTP Combined Quotation Message. The Combined Quote Spin provides the current state of all active participants in the identified security. During the spin, NBBO/BOLO Appendage Indicators are set to 1 until the final participant BBO is disseminated; on the final message they are populated as appropriate.

Field.Name: FINRA ADF MPID Appendage Indicator
Field.Description: FINRA ADF MPID Appendage Indicator. Populated with the FINRA ADF update if necessary.

Message.Name: Odd Lot Quote Message Long Form
Message.Description: Long Format Odd Lot Quotation Message. Sent when a single Combined Quote update exceeds the number of attachments within a single message; carries remaining odd lot updates.

Field.Name: BOLO Appendage Indicator
Field.Description: BOLO Appendage Indicator. 0/1 → no BOLO appendage; 2/3/5 → short/long/MPID-form BOLO follows.

Struct.Name: National BBO Appendage Long-form
Struct.Description: Long-form National BBO Appendage attached when NBBO Appendage Indicator = 3

Field.Name: National Best Bid Price
Field.Description: National Best Bid Price, 6 implied decimal places

Field.Name: National Best Ask Price
Field.Description: National Best Ask Price, 6 implied decimal places

Struct.Name: FINRA ADF MPID Appendage
Struct.Description: FINRA ADF MPID Appendage attached when FINRA ADF MPID Appendage Indicator = 2. Populated with the FINRA ADF update when necessary.

Struct.Name: BOLO Appendage MPID Form
Struct.Description: UTP BOLO Appendage MPID-Form. Appended to odd lot or combined quote messages to provide BOLO information with ADF MPID attribution. Attached when BOLO Appendage Indicator = 5.

Field.Name: BOLO Bid Price
Field.Description: BOLO Bid Price, 6 implied decimal places

Field.Name: BOLO Ask Price
Field.Description: BOLO Ask Price, 6 implied decimal places

Field.Name: BOLO Best Bid Market Participant Identifier
Field.Description: BOLO Best Bid Market Participant Identifier (ADF MPID)

Field.Name: BOLO Best Ask Market Participant Identifier
Field.Description: BOLO Best Ask Market Participant Identifier (ADF MPID)

Group.Name: UTP ADF MPID Odd Lot Attachment
Group.Description: UTP ADF MPID Odd Lot Attachment. Provides one or more odd lot price levels as an attachment to the odd lot or combined quote message, including ADF MPID attribution. Repeats Odd Lot Attachment Count times. ADF Market Participant Identifier is populated with the FINRA ADF MPID update if necessary.

Field.Name: Odd Lot Price
Field.Description: Odd Lot Price, 6 implied decimal places

Field.Name: ADF Market Participant Identifier
Field.Description: ADF Market Participant Identifier (blank if Market Center is not "D")
